content:
Apple will intensively launch a series of new products this autumn, including new iPhone, Mac, iPad and more. Below are all the upcoming Apple new products rumoured to debut starting from 9 September.

iPhone: All-new iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, plus an iPhone Ultra

Apple's flagship iPhone 18 series is heading towards an ultra-premium position this autumn, reportedly with the base iPhone 18 cancelled and pushed back to early 2027 instead.

  • iPhone 18 Pro: Major camera upgrades, unique new colours, a smaller Dynamic Island and more
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max: The largest battery ever, potentially exclusive access to specific camera features
  • iPhone Ultra: Apple's first foldable iPhone

Wearables: AirPods 5, Apple Watch Ultra 4, Apple Watch Series 12

Apple is reportedly set to unveil three new wearables at its September event: AirPods 5, plus updates to two flagship Apple Watch models.

  • AirPods 5: Basic and active noise-cancelling versions updated together
  • Apple Watch Ultra 4: New health sensors, design refresh and more upgrades
  • Apple Watch Series 12: New S-series chip and all-new health features

Mac: MacBook Ultra, all-new M6 MacBook Pro and more

Apple has already launched several new Macs this year, but three more models are reportedly on the way, expected in October.

  • MacBook Ultra: All-new high-end model with OLED display, touch support and more
  • M6 MacBook Pro: Entry-level MacBook Pro updated with the M6 chip
  • M6 iMac: New colour options

iPad: OLED iPad mini, possibly a basic iPad too

New iPad Air models launched earlier this year, but two more iPads may arrive by year-end: an iPad mini with OLED, and an all-new basic iPad.

  • New iPad mini: OLED display and an upgraded chip
  • Basic iPad: A18 chip for Apple Intelligence support

Apple Home products: Apple TV 4K, HomePad and more

Apple intends to significantly expand its home product line, but has reportedly been waiting for Siri AI features to be ready. Here's the lineup of products in the pipeline.

  • New Apple TV 4K: Upgraded A-series chip, Apple Intelligence and an all-new Siri Remote
  • HomePad / HomePod Touch: A new home hub with 7-inch touchscreen and magnetic base
  • HomePod 3: Updated full-size HomePod with a new chip for Apple Intelligence support
  • HomePod mini 2: New chip, improved sound and more upgrades
  • Apple Home camera: First-party smart home accessory supporting HomeKit Secure Video

Apple is also reportedly working on a video doorbell with Face ID, though there has been no update on that for a long time.

Of all the new Apple products launching this autumn, which one are you planning to buy? Let us know in the comments.
